name: qfd_su_cbuf_g_tp8-tp8-COMMIT
purpose: Actual TP8 constant layout; previous TP4 decode was functionally incompatible despite native timing closure

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_su_cbuf_g_tp8 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/redesign_qwen/ot_qfd_crom_lbuf.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: tile_pos
bench.note: eight ot_qfd_su_cbuf_g die tiles (grp 0..7) bit-exact against the constant ROM contract at f_lat 11 / 17 / 5 / 30

bench.name: tile_neg
bench.note: MUT 1, MUT 2, NOWAIT, LATERR (strap one edge off the far ROM latency) each FAIL

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_cbuf_g_tp8/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_cbuf_g_tp8/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_cbuf_g_tp8 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qfd_su_cbuf_g_tp8 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Production TP8 semantic specialization: explicit TP8 masters with QSCALE8832 POST4736 QKR10 and layer stride138; pin/register/clock topology kept from native predecessor. Original TP4 views are not TP8 functional evidence.

reroute_reason.fix: TP8 scale/post bases and layer stride138 replace historical TP4 constants; real ROM/SRAM contents and preserved response edges
